media.note: Single-image mode (IcyQwen3AllInOne 1 widget 4 = 'single', as shipped). LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). For a whole dataset use the `folder` parameter and switch widget 4 to 'batch'; VHS_LoadVideo 14 is the 'video' mode (frames captioned together).

folder.note: A folder on the ComfyUI machine (shipped: E:\ComfyUI\output\lora_dataset). Only read when IcyQwen3AllInOne 1 widget 4 is 'batch'; the runner does not flip that widget.

prompt.note: The caption instruction. The shipped text asks for sexually explicit descriptions; the studio prompt replaces it (for SFW datasets: describe pose, framing, wardrobe, lighting and background, never the person's identity).

captions.note: Writes image + .txt pairs into output/<trigger word> (folder_name and filename_prefix are wired from PrimitiveString 7). The caption is StringConcatenate 8: trigger word, then the model text. ShowText 4 and PreviewImage 5 only display.

notes: Trigger word / character name: PrimitiveString 7 widget 0 (shipped: 'Laura'); set it to the persona's token before a run.

Model: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated-FP8 loaded by IcyQwen3AllInOne 1 widget 0 (icekiub/ComfyUI-IcyQwen3); local, no LM Studio server needed (BLOCKERS 15 concerns captioning_workflow.json, not this file).
